name: Rhude
why: Rhuigi Villaseñor's LA house — Americana rewritten by a Filipino immigrant; the Traxedo track pant and racing graphics at Paris-runway prices.
origin: Rhuigi Villaseñor, LA, 2015 — a Filipino immigrant's single tee cut from a vintage bandana, worn early by Kendrick Lamar; Paris runway by 2019, a Bally creative-director chapter after.
opview: Frames the brand as the American dream, seen through an immigrant's eyes.

notes.status: the Saks featured wall's newest member — celebrity-worn from the first bandana tee
notes.murica: Americana as subject matter — flags, racing stripes, varsity — through an immigrant's lens
notes.style: the Traxedo — tuxedo stripes on a track pant — as the founding design object
notes.street: born from a bandana tee and a Kendrick cosign

cities: LA · Saks & luxury dept stores · SSENSE, Mr Porter
